title: Excellent, very informative tour
text: We had a fabulous trip in Barcelona. They picked us up exactly where we asked at the exact same time we had asked for. Two gentlemen guides extremely informative tour and they were most gracious. Everything went very well. Highly recommend.!!
author: Bernadette_E

title: Lara was a great guide...
text: Lara was a great guide and knows a lot about the history of Barcelona. We loved the flexibility of being able to change schedule as we went.
author: Pam_C

title: A Personalize Private is the Way to Go
text: Wonderful first time tour of Barcelona made most convenient by the guide and a driver who picked us up at the cruise terminal at a convenient time. We started with views rooftop views over the city to get the scope. We then visited the Foundation Joan Miro, a lovely small museum, saw 3 fantastic houses/buildings by the artist Gaudi, and roamed the Gothic quarter. Went to a lovely restaurant for lunch recommended by our college student/art history major guide who grew up in Barcelona and knew the places and architecture, though lacked detailed historical knowledge. We walked Las Ramblas, visite
author: Marcelle_F
